notes.title: Klobgniak 0.3.3.3 (Halloween Update)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

The first update for "[b]Klobgniak[/b]" has arrived!
These are the following changes:

[list]
[*][b]HUD[/b] now shows that you have picked up the "[b]hammer[/b]" or "[b]scissors[/b]".
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added icon "[b]?[/b]" as one of the hints next to the items that the player should pay attention to.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added option for mouse sensitivity in "Pause Menu".
[/list]

[list]
[*] "[b]Collect[/b]" and "[b]Interact[/b]" function is now on the same key ([b]E key[/b]).
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Mr. Resident[/b] is slowed by [b]15%[/b].
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added small details in "[b]Klobgniak's Home[/b]".
[/list]

[b]AND[/b]

[list]
[*] Pumpkin.
[/list]

That's all in this update. Interact with this post and leave your feedback! Also, what do you think about the current state of this game? Your information would help me a lot. 

Thanks in advance!


[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: About "Klobgniak" (future of this game)
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Community![/b]

I will briefly share my opinion and future plans for this project.

Not putting this game in [i]Early Access[/i] might be a beginner's mistake because it will definitely have updates in the near future as well as new content and features depending on your interest and feedback. I also think that through a couple of updates, this game can become interesting for the audience that is looking for games that are puzzling and have tense but simple gameplay at the same time.
Thank you for your understanding and support.

Until the next update!

[b]Cheers![/b]
